method: For each stale review record every reviewed call id is located in the base (main) version of the file. The call must map to exactly one call in the branch version with the same enclosing function, kind, target and ordinal among identical triples. The whole call chain (including predicates) must be byte-identical, and so must its whole enclosing function. Otherwise the record is NOT re-bound.

rebound.manualReview: Manual review of the Zurelay transport fetch in openaiCompat.ts: the fixed provider URL, the beforeDispatch authority binding and redirect:manual are retained. New: a durable per-key pacing lease before dispatch (production), request validation (validateZurelayRequest) before sending, an x-zurelay-fallback: off header so the provider cannot substitute models, and response verification of model, stream and request id afterwards. The lease is released on denial, 429 and redirect. Nothing widens the destination or credential exposure.
